Description: ## 🐛 Bug

<!-- A clear and concise description of what the bug is. -->
I'm encountering the following error when running my code (see below) with multi-GPUs (single GPU and CPU works fine). `accelerator` used is `ddp`.
```
line 117, in test_epoch_end
work = _default_pg.allreduce([tensor], opts)
RuntimeError: self.log("avg_test_acc", avg_test_acc, sync_dist=True)Tensors must be CUDA and dense
```
